name: qlrisk_price_buy_sell_back
title: Price a BuySellBack
description:
Price one Buy/Sell Back (qlrisk BuySellBack).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, principal=1000000, rate_pct=0, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, frequency.
Example: {"maturity": "6M", "principal": 1000000, "rate_pct": 4} gives NPV 998,349.64 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
